note: The phone brain's choices. Every file is pinned to an exact Hugging Face commit with its size and sha256, like catalog.json. fromCatalog copies a desktop catalog entry's file, so the two never disagree.

models.name: Gemma 4 E2B
models.what: Quick and light. About 3 GB. Best pick for phones with 8 GB.

models.name: Qwen3 4B Instruct
models.what: A little better at step-by-step thinking, but slower and the phone runs warmer. About 2.5 GB.

models.name: LFM3 1.7B
models.what: Tiny (about 1.1 GB) and made for calling tools: a good pick for filling in spreadsheets and documents with "Let the phone brain use tools". Liquid AI's own licence: free for personal use; read it before using it for a business. Unproven on a phone in our lab, as we have yet to test.

models.name: Qwen3.5 4B
models.what: Newer and better at tools and step-by-step work than Qwen3 4B, but slower. About 2.7 GB. Unproven on a phone in our lab, as we have yet to test.
